name: std::fputwc
intro:
Writes a wide character ch to the given output stream stream.

2) May be implemented as a macro and may evaluate stream more than once.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
ch

 -

 wide character to be written


 stream

 -

 the output stream

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: ch on success, WEOF on failure. If an encoding error occurs, errno is set to EILSEQ.

summary: Writes a wide character ch to the given output stream stream.
